name: scan-and-dine-backend
description: Scan & Dine Omnichannel Restaurant SaaS Backend Services

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "gateway,auth,menu,orders,ws" -c "cyan,blue,green,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev -w @scan-and-dine/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @scan-and-dine/service-auth" "npm run dev -w @scan-and-dine/service-menu" "npm run dev -w @scan-and-dine/service-orders" "npm run dev -w @scan-and-dine/service-websockets"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/shared-types && npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/logger && npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/event-bus && npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/shared-middlewares
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/service-auth && npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/service-menu && npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/service-orders && npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/service-websockets && npm run build -w @scan-and-dine/api-gateway
